resourceName: Inner Mongolia Moerdaoga Improved Forest Management Project
description:
The Inner Mongolia Moerdaoga Improved Forest Management Project  is located in northern part of the western side of Greater Khingan Mountains, Hulun Buir City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, P.R.C. It is implemented by Moerdaoga Forest Industry Co. LTD  to protect the once logging forest. 
The proposed project is implemented in Angelin, Fenglin, Hongqi, Shengli, Taiping, Xinqing, Yuliya and Hekou Forestry Centers, which is affiliated to Moerdaoga Forest Bureau. The project has 69,199.38 ha commercial forest with 21,045, 6,602, 3,862, 8,520, 6,808, 3,311, 8,220 and 10,831 ha in Angelin, Fenglin, Hongqi, Shengli, Taiping, Xinqing, Yuliya and Hekou forest center respective. The forest ages range from sapling, middle age to mature forest. Prior to the implementation of the project, the forest within the project area was designed and planted as commercial forest, and logged annually according to the timber production plan issued by Moerdaoga Forest Bureau. Since the project started in 2016, the commercial harvest has been cancelled and only tending and managing is allowed.
The project is expected to generate approximately 13,005,555 tCO2e during the 30 years’ crediting period, with the annual emission reductions of 433,519 tCO2e.
The project activity will significantly improve the forest management conditions within the project area, and benefit local ecological environment. The implementation of the project will not only achieve a reliable measurable carbon sequestration by reducing commercial timer, but also contribute to sustainable development of the local community.
